 2026-27 Gamethread #11: New Jersey Devils vs. Los Angeles Kings
 The New Jersey Devils are starting to roll, but will they keep it up this afternoon?
 by Chris Fieldhouse Oct 24, 2026, 5:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 NEWARK, NEW JERSEY - MARCH 14: Nico Hischier #13 of the New Jersey Devils scores a goal on Anton Forsberg #31 of the Los Angeles Kings during the first period of a NHL game at Prudential Center on March 14, 2026 in Newark, New Jersey. (Photo by Andrew Mordzynski/Getty Images) Getty Images The Matchup: New Jersey Devils (6-4-0) vs. Los Angeles Kings (2-4-2 overall)
 The Time: 3:30 PM EDT
 The Broadcast: Local TV — MSGSN; Out of Market — ESPN+, Angels Broadcast Television (ABTV); Radio — Devils Hockey Network 
 The Game Preview: Kurt had it here .
 The Song of the Day: Back when the Devils first introduced their on-ice projection at the Prudential Center, you might remember the drumming intro that accompanied it. That was, if you don’t know, Pink Floyd’s Time , which feels fitting for the events of the last 24 hours. Sunny Mehta has kicked this team into overdrive after some years of floundering and some years of promise.
